scientific_integrity: The rank-one matrix witnesses and both complementary positivity inequalities are explicit; no claim of independent certification or of priority to the known general obstruction.
scientific_limitations: Covariance admissibility is necessary but not sufficient for an implementable completely positive quantum channel.
The universal guarantee is over all admissible covariance inputs and is not a statement that every special fixed point above the threshold is invalid.
The dynamical reachable-state result is restricted to resonant one-mode continuous evolving-correlation equations.
A closely related October 2026 paper establishes the general nonphysicality obstruction; complete text inaccessible, so detailed priority remains uncertain.
title: Sharp fermionic covariance-admissibility frontier for coherence-selective bath resetting
